tags.doneBeforeDependency: Done before what it depends on

empty.title: No tasks yet
empty.body: Type the first task in the field above. You can add the due date now or later.
empty.bodyReadOnly: The organisers have not added any tasks yet.
empty.filteredBody: No task matches what you chose.

calendar.truncated: This month has too many tasks to show them all here. The rest are in the list.

add.title: New task
add.withDetails: Add a task with an owner, a priority and notes

fields.title: What needs doing
fields.ownerHint: A task has one accountable owner. If you choose someone else, we send them an offer they can accept or decline.
fields.ownerHintEdit: To give it to someone else, use “Offer the task” on the task page.
fields.priorityHint: Link the task to one of the occasion's priorities.
fields.parentHint: Choose the bigger task this belongs to.

new.title: New task
new.description: A title is enough. You can fill in the rest at any time.

delete.title: Delete this task?
delete.body: “{title}” is deleted together with its checklist. Its child tasks stay in the plan.

dependencies.title: Depends on
dependencies.empty: It does not depend on any other task.

offer.title: Delegation
offer.declineBody: “{title}” goes back to {from}, who offered it to you. It does not go to anyone else.
offer.reasonHint: The person who offered you the task will see it.
offer.nobodyToOffer: Nobody else is on the team. Invite someone from “Team and roles”.
offer.toHint: They become the owner only if they accept.
offer.waitingTitle: Offered to {to} — waiting for an answer
offer.toYouBody: If you accept, you become its owner. If you decline, it goes back to the person who offered it.
offer.waitingBody: Offer sent on {date}. Until they answer, the owner stays as it is.
offer.declinedBody: Reason: “{reason}”. The task went back to {from}.
offer.none: The task is not on offer to anyone.

doneBeforeDependency.title: Marked done before what it depends on
doneBeforeDependency.body: At least one task it depends on is not done yet. Check the “Depends on” list.

doneWithOpenChildren.title: Done, with open child tasks
doneWithOpenChildren.body: Finish the child tasks or reopen this one, so the plan shows what is true.

blocked.body: You can start it anyway; we only point out what is holding it up.

errors.otherTaskMissing: The chosen task no longer exists in this occasion.
errors.selfParent: A task cannot be part of itself.
errors.parentLoop: The chosen task is already part of this one. Choose another.
errors.selfDependency: A task cannot depend on itself.
errors.dependencyLoop: The chosen task already depends on this one. The link would make a loop.
errors.cannotDelegate: Only organisers, workstream leads and the task's owner can offer it to someone.
errors.offerToSelf: To take the task yourself, choose “Me” as the owner.
errors.offerTargetMissing: That person is no longer on the team, or has not accepted the invitation yet.
errors.notYourOffer: Only the person the task was offered to can answer.
errors.offerClosed: This offer is no longer open.
errors.reasonRequired: Say briefly why you are declining (at least 3 characters).
